title: Fatima Roti Hai Karbal Ka Nazaara Dekhkar
body:
Fatima Sa Roti Hai Karbal Ka Nazaara Dekhkar
nargha E Aada Me Bete Ko Akela Dekhkar
1. Hogaya Pamaal Ran Me Ibne Shabbar Ka Badan
chunte Hain Shabbir Tukde Zarra Zarra Dekhkar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kat Gaye Ghazi Ke Shaane Paani Laane Ke Liye
pyaase Bacche Rehgaye Mashke Sakina Dekhkar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Seena E Akbar As Me Naiza Aur Jawaa'n Bete Ka Gham
haste Jaate Hain Sitamgar Sheh Ka Girna Dekhkar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Akbar As O Abbas As O Qasim As Saare Maqtal Jaa Chuke
aagaye Asghar Bhi Ran Me Sheh Ko Tanha Dekhkar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Teen Din Ka Pyaasa Baccha Hath Par Shabbir Ke
roti Hai Khud Alqama Asghar Ko Pyaasa Dekhkar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hath Me Sughra Ka Khat Hai Godh Me Ashgar Ki Laash
chehra E Asghar Ko Chooma Sheh Ne Naama Dekhkar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Shumre Ka Khanjar Hai Aur Sukha Gala Shabbir Ka
di Sada Ghazi Ko Shai Ne Sooye Darya Dekhakar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Sar Juda Hai Jism Se Aur Hai Badan Me Lakho Teer
roti Hai Baali Sakina Sheh Ka Seena Dekhkar
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Bibiyaa'n Karti Hai Girya Ek Chadar Bhi Nahi
jism Sarwar Ka Pada Hai Paara Paara Dekhkar
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Bekafan Uryaa'n Pada Hai Dasht Me Ibne Ali As
deer Tak Sajjad As Roye Sheh Ka Laasha Dekhkar
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Nouke Naiza Se Wo Girna Aur Rona Ghazi Ka
zainab Sa O Kulsoom Sa Ka Wo Sar Barehna Dekhkar
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Saath Sau Kursi Nashee'n Hai Aur Zainab Berida
aagayi Darbaar Me Bhayya Ka Chehra Dekhkar
<<DIVIDER>>
13. Na Hawa Hai Na Ghiza Hai Aur Andhera Har Taraf
kehti Hai Baali Sakina Sa Khaid Khaana Dekhkar
<<DIVIDER>>
14. Aati Hai Ammar Dekho Majliso Mai Fatema S.a
roti Jaati Hai Azadaro Ka Rona Dekhkar
az: Askari Hussain (ammar)
